title: Fecal Transplant for Severe Alcoholic Liver Diseases Dr Cyriac Abby Philips
description:
#thesciencebrigade #palebluethoughts #stooltransplant 
This is an episode where Dr Cyriac Abby Philips explains his study on how fecal transplants have helped cure people with acute alcoholic liver diseases and prevent them from a relapse. Dr Abby Philips has been selected for delivering the Presidential Plenary, the highest honour for a research given to a clinician scientist, by the American Association for the Study of Liver Diseases (AASLD) for his study on healthy donor stool transplant, three year outcomes in patients with severe alcoholic hepatitis which he submitted to their scientific meeting, The Liver Meeting last year. Only 18 people in the world have been selected for this session. 
None of the premier institutes in India have a Presidential Plenary this year. AIIMS, PGI, SGPGI, VELLORE, nobody got this honour. Only his small unit in Kochi was selected. Also the AASLD team gave Abby the honour of Best of the Liver Meeting for his work on alcoholic hepatitis where he found fecal transplants not only cured people of alcoholic liver diseases, but also this method of treatment helped patients stop alcohol abuse without the need of de-addiction.  
This recording is made public after receiving permission from TSB. This recording is in Malayalam
